full_prompt_en: This square ink-and-color comic scene looks slightly downward onto a very crowded public space filled with people and bicycles. A dark blue-gray brick wall spans the top, interrupted by deep black arched openings. From those openings and the raised background, a tightly packed crowd descends into the middle of the picture. Individual heads and jackets are drawn with small, deliberate black marks; most clothes remain subdued blue, gray, olive, and brown, with occasional yellow, turquoise, orange, and purple accents. In the lower half, bicycles overlap in a complicated lattice of circular wheels, angled frames, handlebars, and spokes. Some people ride, others stand beside their bicycles, and a few walk through the gaps. At the front left, a figure in pink stands beside a pink bicycle. Near the lower center, a smaller pale blue figure holds another bicycle, while a bright yellow bicycle cuts diagonally across the middle-right foreground. At the right, steps and a railing lift a few figures above the roadway, giving the crowd several connected levels. The gray-blue ground remains visible in broad patches at the bottom, with small scattered dark marks rather than rendered pavement texture. Even, cool illumination covers the scene without a strong cast shadow; depth comes from overlap, diminishing figure size, and the dark wall behind. A firm black outline bounds the picture, and fine ink lines keep the busy field readable. The image has the rhythm of a detailed observational comic, where many small actions form one restless, densely patterned whole.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形墨线加彩色漫画场景以微俯视角度望向挤满人与自行车的公共空间。深蓝灰砖墙横贯上方，其间开有幽黑拱门。密集人群从这些开口和抬高的背景向画面中部延伸。每个头部和外套都以细小而明确的黑痕画出；衣服多数是低饱和蓝、灰、橄榄绿和棕，间有黄、青绿、橙与紫色重音。下半部的自行车相互重叠，圆轮、斜车架、车把与辐条交织成复杂网格。有人骑行，有人站在车旁，也有人穿行其间。左前方一名粉衣人物站在粉色自行车旁。靠近下方中央，一位较小的浅蓝色人物握着另一辆车；一辆亮黄自行车斜穿右侧中前景。右边的台阶与栏杆把几个人抬到道路上方，使拥挤场面有相互连接的多个高度。灰蓝地面在下方仍以宽阔斑块露出，上面只有零散深痕，而非细绘的铺地纹理。均匀冷光覆盖场景，没有很强的投影；纵深由遮挡、渐小人物与后方暗墙形成。坚实黑轮廓圈住画面，细墨线使繁忙色域仍然易读。作品具有细致观察式漫画的节奏，众多小动作汇成躁动且密集的整体纹样。
style_prompt_en: Observational comic drawing organizes a crowded surface with crisp black outlines, small repeated marks, and restrained flat color. Cool blue-gray grounds and darker recesses hold a dense web of overlapping shapes, while a few bright pink, yellow, orange, and cyan accents guide attention through the complexity. Depth grows from changes in scale, stepped levels, and occlusion instead of atmospheric blur. Simplified forms retain enough varied posture and local detail to feel lively. Broad quiet patches at the edge balance densely worked central areas, creating a legible, bustling rhythm under even light.
style_prompt_zh: 观察式漫画绘制用清晰黑轮廓、小型重复痕迹与克制平涂色组织拥挤表面。冷蓝灰底色和更深的凹处托住密集交叠的形状网络，少数亮粉、黄、橙与青色重音引导视线穿过复杂区域。纵深来自尺度变化、阶梯式高度和遮挡，而非空气透视模糊。简化形体仍保留足够多样的姿态与局部细节，显得生动。边缘宽阔安静的色块平衡中央精密区域，在均匀光下形成易读而忙碌的节奏。
theme_en: A dense crowd of people and bicycles outside a blue-gray brick building
theme_zh: 蓝灰砖建筑前拥挤的人群与自行车
name: Ted Rall
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
